description: You are the HR Manager at a software company. A new developer, Jordan Kim, was just added to the system as a placeholder but their employee record is nearly blank. You need to complete the full onboarding profile before their first day. Log in to Odoo at http://localhost:8069 with username admin and password admin. Find the employee record for 'Jordan Kim' and complete it with the following information: Job Position = 'Experienced Developer', Department = 'Research & Development', Manager = 'Marc Demo', Coach = 'Eli Lambert', Work Phone = '+1 555 234 5678', Work Email = 'jordan.kim@company.com'. Then add the employee tags 'Employee' and 'Trainer' to their profile. Finally, set up their leave entitlements by creating an approved Paid Time Off allocation of 20 days and an approved Compensatory Days allocation of 5 days.
